interpretation.why_full_centroid_is_not_evidence: A_full is the centroid of the very identities it is scored against, so a high top-1 recovers the label set by construction. The leave-identity-out arm is the only admissible test.
interpretation.why_the_random_control_matters: A fixed axiom scores a candidate identically in every query, so it reads the identity concentration (22 distinct correct identities over 572 pairs). The random arm measures that floor; any arm must clear it.
interpretation.earlier_defect_corrected: the previous probe reported chance_top1 from len(block)/K, which is 1.0 and not a chance level. Chance is (mean correct candidates per query)/K.
interpretation.scope: encoder waves, NOT EFE-planned candidates; no task attempted or solved.
